list.name: location
list.label: Lieu
list.query: SELECT CASE location WHEN 'LAN' THEN 'Sur place (LAN)' ELSE 'À distance (online)' END AS __text, location AS __value FROM streamer_v WHERE location IS NOT NULL GROUP BY location ORDER BY location
list.definition: SELECT CASE location WHEN 'LAN' THEN 'Sur place (LAN)' ELSE 'À distance (online)' END AS __text, location AS __value FROM streamer_v WHERE location IS NOT NULL GROUP BY location ORDER BY location

panels.title: Rythme des dons, 10 dernières min

targets.rawSql: WITH cur AS (SELECT ts, donation_total FROM snapshot ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1), past AS (SELECT sn.donation_total FROM snapshot sn, cur WHERE sn.ts <= cur.ts - interval '10 minutes'          ORDER BY sn.ts DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT (cur.donation_total - past.donation_total) / 10 FROM cur, past

panels.description: Gain du total de l'événement par minute sur les 10 dernières minutes de données.

panels.title: Rythme moyen depuis le début

targets.rawSql: SELECT (max(donation_total) - min(donation_total)) / greatest(extract(epoch FROM max(ts) - min(ts)) / 60, 1) FROM snapshot

panels.description: Total de l'événement par minute, sur tout l'événement.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (floor(donation_total / 1e6) + 1) * 1e6 FROM snapshot ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Prochain million dans

targets.rawSql: WITH cur AS (SELECT ts, donation_total FROM snapshot ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1), past AS (SELECT sn.donation_total FROM snapshot sn, cur WHERE sn.ts <= cur.ts - interval '10 minutes'          ORDER BY sn.ts DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT CASE WHEN cur.donation_total > past.donation_total THEN ((floor(cur.donation_total / 1e6) + 1) * 1e6 - cur.donation_total) / ((cur.donation_total - past.donation_total) / 600.0) END FROM cur, past

panels.description: Au rythme des dons des 10 dernières minutes.

panels.title: Total projeté à la fin (rythme 1 h)

targets.rawSql: WITH cur AS (SELECT ts, donation_total FROM snapshot ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1), past AS (SELECT sn.ts, sn.donation_total FROM snapshot sn, cur WHERE sn.ts <= cur.ts - interval '1 hours'          ORDER BY sn.ts DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT cur.donation_total + (cur.donation_total - past.donation_total) / extract(epoch FROM cur.ts - past.ts) * greatest(extract(epoch FROM '2026-09-07 00:00:00+00'::timestamptz - cur.ts), 0) FROM cur, past

panels.description: Total actuel plus le rythme de la dernière heure tenu jusqu'à la fin de l'événement (lundi 02h00, heure de Paris).

panels.title: Total projeté à la fin (rythme 6 h)

targets.rawSql: WITH cur AS (SELECT ts, donation_total FROM snapshot ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1), past AS (SELECT sn.ts, sn.donation_total FROM snapshot sn, cur WHERE sn.ts <= cur.ts - interval '6 hours'          ORDER BY sn.ts DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT cur.donation_total + (cur.donation_total - past.donation_total) / extract(epoch FROM cur.ts - past.ts) * greatest(extract(epoch FROM '2026-09-07 00:00:00+00'::timestamptz - cur.ts), 0) FROM cur, past

panels.description: Total actuel plus le rythme des 6 dernières heures tenu jusqu'à la fin de l'événement (lundi 02h00, heure de Paris).

panels.title: Dernière heure, et hier à la même heure

targets.rawSql: WITH cur AS (SELECT max(ts) AS at FROM snapshot) SELECT (SELECT (array_agg(donation_total ORDER BY ts DESC))[1] - (array_agg(donation_total ORDER BY ts))[1] FROM snapshot WHERE ts > cur.at - interval '1 hour') AS "Dernière heure",        (SELECT (array_agg(donation_total ORDER BY ts DESC))[1] - (array_agg(donation_total ORDER BY ts))[1] FROM snapshot WHERE ts > cur.at - interval '25 hours'         AND ts <= cur.at - interval '24 hours') AS "Hier, même heure" FROM cur

panels.description: Gain du total de l'événement sur la dernière heure de données, et sur la même heure 24 h plus tôt.

panels.title: Dernier relevé il y a

targets.rawSql: SELECT extract(epoch FROM now() - max(ts)) FROM snapshot

panels.description: Âge du dernier relevé de l'API (un relevé par minute en temps normal).

panels.title: Les millions, un par un

targets.rawSql: WITH m AS (  SELECT ts, floor(max(donation_total) OVER (ORDER BY ts) / 1e6) AS mil FROM snapshot), c AS (  SELECT ts, mil, lag(mil) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS prev FROM m), x AS (SELECT ts, mil FROM c WHERE prev IS NOT NULL AND mil > prev) SELECT mil * 1e6 AS "Palier", ts AS "Atteint à",        extract(epoch FROM ts - lag(ts) OVER (ORDER BY ts)) AS "Après le précédent",        extract(epoch FROM ts - (SELECT min(ts) FROM snapshot)) AS "Depuis le début" FROM x ORDER BY mil DESC

panels.description: Quand le total de l'événement a franchi chaque million rond (maximum glissant : une baisse du compteur ne peut pas franchir deux fois le même million).

panels.title: Plus gros gains en une minute

targets.rawSql: WITH e AS (  SELECT s.ts, s.twitch_id, s.gain AS delta FROM streamer_sample_v s  WHERE $__timeFilter(s.ts) AND NOT s.derived AND s.gain > 0 AND s.gap_s <= 300  ORDER BY s.gain DESC LIMIT 200) SELECT e.ts AS "Heure", st.display AS "Streamer", e.delta AS "Gain", st.login AS login FROM e JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) WHERE st.login NOT IN ('zevent', 'zeventplays') AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM streamer_sample_v p WHERE p.twitch_id = e.twitch_id                 AND p.ts < e.ts AND p.ts >= e.ts - interval '10 minutes' AND p.gain <= -0.9 * e.delta) ORDER BY e.delta DESC LIMIT 25

panels.description: Gains du compteur d'un streamer en une minute. Les chaînes de l'organisation (ZEVENT, ZEventPlays) sont exclues : leurs compteurs bougent par paquets (billets, boutique) et, avant le 4 sept. 22:58 CEST, viennent d'une source relevée toutes les 30 minutes. Les gains sont mesurés entre deux relevés espacés d'au plus 5 minutes, pour qu'un trou dans les données ne compte pas comme une minute. Le retour à la normale après un raté de l'API (un compteur qui tombe à 0 et revient quelques minutes plus tard) est exclu : les lignes dont le streamer a perdu au moins 90 % du montant dans les 10 minutes précédentes sont ignorées.

panels.title: Paliers des streamers

targets.rawSql: SELECT st.profile_url AS "Avatar", st.display AS "Streamer", t.v AS "Palier", min(s.ts) AS "Atteint à",        st.login AS login FROM (VALUES (100000), (250000), (500000), (1000000), (2000000), (3000000), (5000000)) t(v) JOIN streamer_sample_v s ON s.donation_total >= t.v JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) WHERE NOT st.derived AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$' GROUP BY st.profile_url, st.display, t.v, st.login HAVING min(s.ts) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() ORDER BY min(s.ts) DESC LIMIT 25

panels.description: Quand chaque streamer a franchi 100 K, 250 K, 500 K, 1 M, 2 M, 3 M ou 5 M€ pour la première fois (les franchissements dans la plage de temps sélectionnée, les plus récents en premier).

panels.title: Changements de leader

targets.rawSql: WITH l AS (SELECT ts, twitch_id, donation_total, lag(twitch_id) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS prev            FROM streamer_sample_v WHERE rank = 1 AND NOT derived AND donation_total > 0) SELECT l.ts AS "Heure", st.profile_url AS "Avatar", st.display AS "Streamer",        coalesce(p.display, '—') AS "Remplace", l.donation_total AS "Cagnotte", st.login AS login FROM l JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) LEFT JOIN streamer_v p ON p.twitch_id = l.prev WHERE l.prev IS DISTINCT FROM l.twitch_id AND $__timeFilter(l.ts) ORDER BY l.ts DESC LIMIT 25

panels.description: Chaque fois que la première place du classement des dons a changé de mains, avec la cagnotte du nouveau leader à ce moment.

panels.title: Plus gros bonds de viewers en une minute

targets.rawSql: WITH e AS (SELECT s.ts, s.twitch_id, s.viewers_gain, s.viewers FROM streamer_sample_v s            WHERE $__timeFilter(s.ts) AND NOT s.derived AND s.viewers_gain > 0              AND s.viewers - s.viewers_gain > 0 AND s.gap_s <= 300 ORDER BY s.viewers_gain DESC LIMIT 200) SELECT e.ts AS "Heure", st.profile_url AS "Avatar", st.display AS "Streamer", e.viewers_gain AS "Bond",        e.viewers AS "Viewers après", st.login AS login FROM e JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) WHERE coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$' ORDER BY e.viewers_gain DESC LIMIT 25

panels.description: Plus fortes hausses du nombre de viewers d'un streamer entre deux relevés (raids, co-streams, moments forts). Les passages en live (de 0 viewer à N) ne comptent pas.

panels.title: Plus fortes montées au classement

targets.rawSql: WITH cur AS (SELECT max(ts) AS ts FROM snapshot), n AS (SELECT s.twitch_id, s.rank, s.donation_total FROM streamer_sample_v s, cur WHERE s.ts = cur.ts AND NOT s.derived), h AS (SELECT s.twitch_id, s.rank FROM streamer_sample_v s WHERE NOT s.derived       AND s.ts = (SELECT max(sn.ts) FROM snapshot sn, cur WHERE sn.ts <= cur.ts - interval '1 hour')), d AS (SELECT s.twitch_id, s.rank FROM streamer_sample_v s WHERE NOT s.derived       AND s.ts = (SELECT max(sn.ts) FROM snapshot sn, cur WHERE sn.ts <= cur.ts - interval '24 hours')) SELECT st.profile_url AS "Avatar", st.display AS "Streamer", n.rank AS "Rang", h.rank - n.rank AS "Sur 1 h",        d.rank - n.rank AS "Sur 24 h", n.donation_total AS "Cagnotte", st.login AS login FROM n JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) LEFT JOIN h USING (twitch_id) LEFT JOIN d USING (twitch_id) WHERE coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$' AND (h.rank <> n.rank OR d.rank <> n.rank) ORDER BY coalesce(d.rank - n.rank, 0) DESC, coalesce(h.rank - n.rank, 0) DESC, n.rank LIMIT 25

panels.description: Places gagnées (ou perdues, en rouge) au classement des dons depuis 1 h et depuis 24 h, au dernier relevé.

panels.title: Dons par heure de la journée (Europe/Paris)

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(h, 'FM00"h"') AS "Heure", sum(sg) AS "À un streamer",        sum(g - sg) AS "Sans streamer" FROM (  SELECT extract(hour FROM gl.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris') AS h, gl.g, coalesce(st.sg, 0) AS sg  FROM (SELECT ts, donation_total - lag(donation_total) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS g FROM snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)) gl  LEFT JOIN (SELECT ts, sum(gain) AS sg FROM streamer_sample_v WHERE NOT derived AND $__timeFilter(ts)             GROUP BY ts) st USING (ts)) d WHERE g IS NOT NULL GROUP BY h ORDER BY h

panels.description: Gain du total de l'événement par heure de la journée, additionné sur la période sélectionnée (tous lieux), séparé entre ce que les compteurs des streamers ont gagné et le reste. Tous les dons qui n'ont pas pu être rattachés à un streamer : le total de l'événement moins la somme des compteurs des streamers. On y trouve les dons faits sans choisir de streamer (la page d'équipe Streamlabs Charity sans membre), les billets du concert de jeudi, tous les dons de la boutique, etc.

panels.title: Dons par viewer-heure

targets.rawSql: WITH v AS (  SELECT x.twitch_id, sum(x.viewers * least(x.gap_s, 300)) / 3600.0 AS viewer_hours,          sum(least(x.gap_s, 300)) FILTER (WHERE x.online) / 3600.0 AS hours  FROM streamer_sample_v x WHERE $__timeFilter(x.ts) AND x.gap_s IS NOT NULL GROUP BY x.twitch_id), g AS (  SELECT s.twitch_id, sum(s.gain) AS gained FROM streamer_sample_v s  WHERE $__timeFilter(s.ts) AND s.gain IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.twitch_id) SELECT st.profile_url AS "Avatar", st.display AS "Streamer", g.gained / v.viewer_hours AS "Par viewer-heure", g.gained AS "Gagné", v.viewer_hours AS "Viewer-heures", v.hours AS "Heures", st.login AS login FROM g JOIN v USING (twitch_id) JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) WHERE NOT st.derived AND v.viewer_hours >= 100 AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$' ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 25

panels.description: Gagné sur la période sélectionnée divisé par les viewer-heures (viewers additionnés dans le temps) : ce qu'une communauté donne par rapport à sa taille. Les streamers avec moins de 100 viewer-heures sont exclus.

panels.title: Tendance du moment (15 dernières minutes)

targets.rawSql: WITH cur AS (SELECT max(ts) AS ts FROM snapshot), n AS (SELECT twitch_id, donation_total, viewers FROM streamer_sample_v, cur WHERE streamer_sample_v.ts = cur.ts), p AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (ss.twitch_id) ss.twitch_id, ss.donation_total, ss.viewers FROM streamer_sample_v ss, cur       WHERE ss.ts BETWEEN cur.ts - interval '60 minutes' AND cur.ts - interval '15 minutes'       ORDER BY ss.twitch_id, ss.ts DESC) SELECT st.profile_url AS "Avatar", st.display AS "Streamer", n.donation_total - p.donation_total AS "Gagné", n.viewers AS "Viewers", n.viewers - p.viewers AS "Variation viewers", st.login AS login FROM n JOIN p USING (twitch_id) JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) WHERE NOT st.derived AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$' ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 25

panels.description: Streamers classés par dons gagnés sur les 15 dernières minutes de données, avec la variation du nombre de viewers (par rapport au dernier relevé vieux d'au moins 15 minutes, en remontant jusqu'à une heure).

panels.title: Dons gagnés par intervalle, par lieu

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(d.ts, $__interval), CASE st.location WHEN 'LAN' THEN 'Sur place (LAN)' WHEN 'Online' THEN 'À distance (online)' ELSE 'Inconnu' END AS metric, sum(d.gain) AS value FROM streamer_sample_v d JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) WHERE $__timeFilter(d.ts) AND NOT d.derived AND d.gain IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Rythme des dons par minute (1 h glissante)

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.ts AS time, (a.donation_total - b.donation_total) / (extract(epoch FROM a.ts - b.ts) / 60) AS "Rythme sur 1 h",        (SELECT (max(donation_total) - min(donation_total)) / greatest(extract(epoch FROM max(ts) - min(ts)) / 60, 1)         FROM snapshot) AS "Moyenne de l'événement" FROM snapshot a JOIN LATERAL (SELECT ts, donation_total FROM snapshot b WHERE b.ts <= a.ts - interval '1 hour'                               ORDER BY b.ts DESC LIMIT 1) b ON true WHERE $__timeFilter(a.ts) ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Gain du total de l'événement par minute, moyenné sur l'heure qui précède chaque point, comparé au rythme moyen depuis le début. Un pic d'une heure suit chaque gros versement (boutique, billets).

panels.title: Dons par viewer-heure au fil du temps

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(x.ts, $__interval), sum(x.gain) / nullif(sum(x.viewers * least(x.gap_s, 300)) / 3600.0, 0) AS "Dons par viewer-heure" FROM streamer_sample_v x JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) WHERE $__timeFilter(x.ts) AND NOT st.derived AND x.gap_s IS NOT NULL AND st.login NOT IN ('zevent', 'zeventplays') AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Générosité par intervalle : dons gagnés par les streamers correspondant au filtre Lieu divisés par leurs viewer-heures sur l'intervalle. Les chaînes de l'organisation (billets, boutique) sont exclues.

panels.title: Viewers par heure de la journée (Europe/Paris)

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(h, 'FM00"h"') AS "Heure", round(avg(v)) AS "Moyenne", max(v) AS "Pic" FROM (  SELECT extract(hour FROM s.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris') AS h, s.ts, sum(s.viewers) AS v  FROM streamer_sample_v s JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id)  WHERE $__timeFilter(s.ts) AND NOT st.derived AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$' GROUP BY s.ts) x GROUP BY h ORDER BY h

panels.description: Viewers cumulés des streamers correspondant au filtre Lieu, par heure de la journée sur la période sélectionnée : moyenne des relevés et plus haut relevé.

panels.title: Jour par jour (Europe/Paris)

targets.rawSql: WITH d AS (  SELECT (ts AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date AS day, (array_agg(donation_total ORDER BY ts DESC))[1] - (array_agg(donation_total ORDER BY ts))[1] AS gained, round(avg(viewers_total)) AS avg_v,          max(viewers_total) AS peak_v FROM snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1), h AS (  SELECT (s.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date AS day, sum(least(s.gap_s, 300)) FILTER (WHERE s.online) / 3600.0 AS hours,          count(DISTINCT s.twitch_id) FILTER (WHERE s.online) AS live  FROM streamer_sample_v s JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id)  WHERE $__timeFilter(s.ts) AND NOT st.derived AND s.gap_s IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$' GROUP BY 1) SELECT to_char(d.day, 'DD/MM') AS "Jour", d.gained AS "Dons", d.avg_v AS "Viewers moyens", d.peak_v AS "Pic de viewers",        h.hours AS "Heures de stream", h.live AS "Streamers en live" FROM d LEFT JOIN h USING (day) ORDER BY d.day

panels.description: Par jour calendaire : gain du total de l'événement et viewers (tous lieux), heures de stream et streamers passés en live (filtre Lieu).

panels.title: Part des compteurs des streamers

targets.rawSql: WITH cur AS (SELECT s.twitch_id, s.donation_total FROM streamer_sample_v s JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id)              WHERE s.ts = (SELECT max(ts) FROM snapshot) AND NOT st.derived AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$'), r AS (SELECT twitch_id, donation_total, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY donation_total DESC) AS rn,              sum(donation_total) OVER () AS tot, count(*) OVER () AS n FROM cur) SELECT CASE WHEN rn <= 10 THEN rn || '. ' || st.display ELSE 'Les ' || (n - 10) || ' autres' END AS "Streamer",        sum(donation_total / nullif(tot, 0)) AS "Part" FROM r JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) GROUP BY 1, rn <= 10 ORDER BY min(rn)

panels.description: Part de la somme des compteurs des streamers (filtre Lieu) détenue par chacun des dix premiers, et par tous les autres réunis, au dernier relevé.

panels.title: Part détenue par le haut du classement

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, sum(donation_total) FILTER (WHERE rank <= 1) / nullif(sum(donation_total), 0) AS "Top 1",        sum(donation_total) FILTER (WHERE rank <= 10) / nullif(sum(donation_total), 0) AS "Top 10",        sum(donation_total) FILTER (WHERE rank <= 25) / nullif(sum(donation_total), 0) AS "Top 25" FROM streamer_sample_v WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND NOT derived GROUP BY ts ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Part de la somme des compteurs des streamers détenue par le premier, les dix premiers et les vingt-cinq premiers du classement, au fil du temps (tous lieux).

panels.title: Streamers par palier de cagnotte

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.ts AS time, CASE WHEN s.donation_total >= 1e6 THEN '1 M€ et plus' WHEN s.donation_total >= 1e5 THEN '100 K à 1 M€'        WHEN s.donation_total >= 1e4 THEN '10 K à 100 K€' WHEN s.donation_total >= 1e3 THEN '1 K à 10 K€' ELSE 'Moins de 1 K€' END AS metric,        count(*) AS value FROM streamer_sample_v s JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) WHERE $__timeFilter(s.ts) AND NOT st.derived AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Nombre de streamers (filtre Lieu) dont la cagnotte est dans chaque tranche, au fil du temps.

panels.title: Viewers et dons, un point par streamer

targets.rawSql: WITH v AS (  SELECT x.twitch_id, sum(x.viewers * least(x.gap_s, 300)) / 3600.0 AS viewer_hours, sum(least(x.gap_s, 300)) FILTER (WHERE x.online) / 3600.0 AS hours  FROM streamer_sample_v x WHERE $__timeFilter(x.ts) AND x.gap_s IS NOT NULL GROUP BY x.twitch_id), g AS (  SELECT s.twitch_id, sum(s.gain) AS gained FROM streamer_sample_v s  WHERE $__timeFilter(s.ts) AND s.gain IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.twitch_id) SELECT st.display AS "Streamer", round(v.viewer_hours / nullif(v.hours, 0)) AS "Viewers moyens en live",        g.gained AS "Gagné sur la période" FROM g JOIN v USING (twitch_id) JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) WHERE NOT st.derived AND v.viewer_hours >= 100 AND v.hours > 0 AND g.gained > 0 AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$' ORDER BY 3 DESC

panels.description: Chaque point est un streamer : ses viewers moyens quand il est en live (horizontal) et ce qu'il a gagné sur la période (vertical), échelles logarithmiques. Les points au-dessus du nuage sont les communautés qui donnent le plus par rapport à leur taille. Survolez un point pour le nom.

panels.title: Dons reçus pendant le live et hors live

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(s.gain) FILTER (WHERE s.online), 0) AS "En live",        coalesce(sum(s.gain) FILTER (WHERE NOT s.online), 0) AS "Hors live" FROM streamer_sample_v s JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) WHERE $__timeFilter(s.ts) AND NOT st.derived AND s.gain IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$'

panels.description: Dons gagnés par les compteurs des streamers (filtre Lieu) sur la période, selon que le streamer était en live ou non au moment du relevé.

panels.title: Streamers dont la cagnotte dépasse

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.donation_total >= 1e3) AS "1 K€", count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.donation_total >= 1e4) AS "10 K€",        count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.donation_total >= 1e5) AS "100 K€", count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.donation_total >= 1e6) AS "1 M€" FROM streamer_sample_v s JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) WHERE s.ts = (SELECT max(ts) FROM snapshot) AND NOT st.derived AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$'

panels.description: Nombre de streamers (filtre Lieu) dont la cagnotte dépasse chaque seuil, au dernier relevé.

panels.title: Plus longues sessions en live

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (  SELECT x.twitch_id, max(x.ts - coalesce(x.offline_at, st.first_seen)) AS longest  FROM streamer_sample_v x JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id)  WHERE $__timeFilter(x.ts) AND x.online AND NOT st.derived AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$' GROUP BY x.twitch_id), cur AS (  SELECT x.twitch_id, CASE WHEN x.online THEN x.ts - coalesce(x.offline_at, st.first_seen) END AS current  FROM streamer_sample_v x JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) WHERE x.ts = (SELECT max(ts) FROM snapshot)) SELECT st.profile_url AS "Avatar", st.display AS "Streamer", extract(epoch FROM s.longest) / 3600.0 AS "Plus longue session",        extract(epoch FROM cur.current) / 3600.0 AS "Session en cours", st.login AS login FROM s JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) LEFT JOIN cur USING (twitch_id) ORDER BY s.longest DESC LIMIT 25

panels.description: Plus long passage en live sans interruption observé sur la période (il peut avoir commencé avant), et la durée de la session en cours si le streamer est en live.

panels.title: Dons par heure de live

targets.rawSql: WITH h AS (  SELECT s.twitch_id, sum(least(s.gap_s, 300)) FILTER (WHERE s.online) / 3600.0 AS hours  FROM streamer_sample_v s WHERE $__timeFilter(s.ts) AND s.gap_s IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.twitch_id) , g AS (  SELECT s.twitch_id, sum(s.gain) AS gained FROM streamer_sample_v s  WHERE $__timeFilter(s.ts) AND s.gain IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.twitch_id) SELECT st.profile_url AS "Avatar", st.display AS "Streamer", g.gained / nullif(h.hours, 0) AS "Par heure de live",        g.gained AS "Gagné", h.hours AS "Heures", st.login AS login FROM g JOIN h USING (twitch_id) JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) WHERE NOT st.derived AND h.hours >= 3 AND st.login NOT IN ('zevent', 'zeventplays') AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$' ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 25

panels.description: Gagné sur la période divisé par les heures passées en live. Les streamers avec moins de 3 heures de live et les chaînes de l'organisation sont exclus.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.ts AS time, CASE st.location WHEN 'LAN' THEN 'Sur place (LAN)' WHEN 'Online' THEN 'À distance (online)' ELSE 'Inconnu' END AS metric, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.online) AS value FROM streamer_sample_v s JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) WHERE $__timeFilter(s.ts) AND NOT st.derived AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT s.ts AS time, CASE st.location WHEN 'LAN' THEN 'Sur place (LAN)' WHEN 'Online' THEN 'À distance (online)' ELSE 'Inconnu' END AS metric, sum(s.viewers) AS value FROM streamer_sample_v s JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) WHERE $__timeFilter(s.ts) AND NOT st.derived AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Cagnottes par lieu

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.ts AS time, CASE st.location WHEN 'LAN' THEN 'Sur place (LAN)' WHEN 'Online' THEN 'À distance (online)' ELSE 'Inconnu' END AS metric, sum(s.donation_total) AS value FROM streamer_sample_v s JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) WHERE $__timeFilter(s.ts) AND NOT st.derived AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Somme des compteurs des streamers sur place et à distance, au fil du temps.

panels.title: Part des dons sur place

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(s.donation_total) FILTER (WHERE st.location = 'LAN') / nullif(sum(s.donation_total), 0) FROM streamer_sample_v s JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) WHERE s.ts = (SELECT max(ts) FROM snapshot) AND NOT st.derived

panels.description: Part de la somme des compteurs des streamers détenue par les streamers sur place, au dernier relevé.

targets.rawSql: SELECT avg(s.donation_total) FILTER (WHERE st.location = 'LAN') AS "Sur place",        avg(s.donation_total) FILTER (WHERE st.location = 'Online') AS "À distance" FROM streamer_sample_v s JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) WHERE s.ts = (SELECT max(ts) FROM snapshot) AND NOT st.derived

panels.title: Dons gagnés sur la période, par lieu

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(s.gain) FILTER (WHERE st.location = 'LAN'), 0) AS "Sur place",        coalesce(sum(s.gain) FILTER (WHERE st.location = 'Online'), 0) AS "À distance" FROM streamer_sample_v s JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) WHERE $__timeFilter(s.ts) AND NOT st.derived AND s.gain IS NOT NULL

WITH top AS (SELECT game FROM streamer_sample_v s JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) WHERE $__timeFilter(s.ts) AND s.online AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$' GROUP BY game ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 8) SELECT ts AS time, CASE WHEN game IN (SELECT game FROM top) THEN game ELSE 'Autre' END AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM streamer_sample_v s JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) WHERE $__timeFilter(s.ts) AND s.online AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

WITH top AS (SELECT game FROM streamer_sample_v s JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) WHERE $__timeFilter(s.ts) AND s.online AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$' GROUP BY game ORDER BY sum(viewers) DESC LIMIT 8) SELECT ts AS time, CASE WHEN game IN (SELECT game FROM top) THEN game ELSE 'Autre' END AS metric, sum(viewers) AS value FROM streamer_sample_v s JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) WHERE $__timeFilter(s.ts) AND s.online AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT coalesce(x.game, '(sans jeu)') AS "Jeu", sum(least(x.gap_s, 300)) / 3600.0 AS "Heures",        count(DISTINCT x.twitch_id) AS "Streamers", sum(x.viewers * least(x.gap_s, 300)) / 3600.0 AS "Viewer-heures" FROM streamer_sample_v x JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) WHERE $__timeFilter(x.ts) AND NOT st.derived AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$' AND x.online AND x.gap_s IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Au fil du temps (total moins tous les streamers)

targets.rawSql: SELECT sn.ts AS time, sn.donation_total - sum(s.donation_total) FILTER (WHERE NOT s.derived) AS "Sans streamer", coalesce(sum(s.donation_total) FILTER (WHERE s.derived), 0) AS "Cagnotte spéciale du Vieux Monsieur" FROM snapshot sn JOIN streamer_sample_v s USING (ts) WHERE $__timeFilter(sn.ts) GROUP BY sn.ts, sn.donation_total ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Tous les dons qui n'ont pas pu être rattachés à un streamer : le total de l'événement moins la somme des compteurs des streamers. On y trouve les dons faits sans choisir de streamer (la page d'équipe Streamlabs Charity sans membre), les billets du concert de jeudi, tous les dons de la boutique, etc.

panels.title: Par intervalle (gain total moins gains des streamers)

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, $__interval), sum(g) - sum(sg) AS "Sans streamer" FROM (  SELECT ts, donation_total - lag(donation_total) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS g FROM snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)) gl JOIN (  SELECT ts, sum(gain) AS sg FROM streamer_sample_v WHERE NOT derived AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY ts) st USING (ts) WHERE g IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Relevés sur la période

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.description: Nombre de relevés de l'API dans la plage de temps (un par minute).

panels.title: Trous de collecte

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT ts - lag(ts) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS d FROM snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)) x WHERE d > interval '90 seconds'

panels.description: Nombre de fois où plus de 90 secondes séparent deux relevés (API injoignable ou collecteur arrêté).

panels.title: Ratés de l'API

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM streamer_sample_v WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND NOT derived AND gain < -100

panels.description: Relevés où le compteur d'un streamer a perdu plus de 100 € (en général un compteur tombé à 0 et rétabli quelques minutes plus tard).
